### Правила генерации SQL:
1. Всегда используй алиасы для таблиц в JOIN
2. Всегда экранируй названия через двойные кавычки
3. Только SELECT запросы (никаких модификаций)

   Если запрос на английском — работай с английскими значениями без изменений.
8. Если тебя просят посчитать среднее, не округляй и не делай cast в integer!
9. Если тебя просят вывести топ-N значений, ОНИ ДОЛЖНЫ БЫТЬ УНИКАЛЬНЫМИ, ВСЕГДА ИСПОЛЬЗУЙ ГРУППИРОВКУ !!!
10. Обрати внимание, что все поля имеют тип TEXT, так что перед тем как сравнивать их, должным образом предобработай!

/* Средний балл по математике выше 560 в SAT, школы с прямым финансированием чартера */
SELECT COUNT(DISTINCT s."cdscode") AS school_count
FROM satscores sc
JOIN schools s ON s."cdscode" = sc."cds"
WHERE sc."avgscrmath" > 560
  AND s."fundingtype" = 'Directly funded';
```

/* Извлекаем имена администраторов из трёх полей admfname1/2/3, объединяем, считаем частоту */
WITH admin_names AS (
    SELECT "admfname1" AS fname, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname1" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname1" <> 'None'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname2" AS fname, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname2" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname2" <> 'None'
    UNION ALL
    SELECT "admfname3" AS fname, "district" FROM schools WHERE "admfname3" IS NOT NULL AND "admfname3" <> 'None'
),
name_counts AS (
    SELECT fname, COUNT(*) AS cnt
    FROM admin_names
    GROUP BY fname
    ORDER BY cnt DESC
    LIMIT 2
)
/* Для каждого из двух самых частых имён выводим округ(а) */
SELECT nc.fname, nc.cnt, an.district
FROM name_counts nc
JOIN admin_names an ON an.fname = nc.fname
GROUP BY nc.fname, nc.cnt, an.district
ORDER BY nc.cnt DESC, nc.fname, an.district;
```

WITH school_scores AS (

    LIMIT 1
)

    ls."sname" AS school_name,
    ls."cname" AS county,
    ls."avgscrmath" AS avg_math_score

/* Средний балл по письму для школ, открытых после 1991 или закрытых до 2000, с названием и телефоном */
SELECT
    s."school" AS school_name,
    AVG(ss."avgscrwrite") AS avg_writing_score,
    s."phone" AS phone_number
FROM schools s
JOIN satscores ss
    ON ss."cds" = s."cdscode"
WHERE
    (s."opendate" IS NOT NULL AND s."opendate"::date > DATE '1991-12-31')
    OR (s."closeddate" IS NOT NULL AND s."closeddate"::date < DATE '2000-01-01')
GROUP BY s."school", s."phone"
ORDER BY avg_writing_score DESC;
```

/* Находим округ (county) с наибольшим числом закрытых школ и выводим названия школ и даты закрытия */
WITH closed_counts AS (
    SELECT
        s."county",
        COUNT(*) AS closed_school_count
    FROM schools s
    WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
    GROUP BY s."county"
    ORDER BY closed_school_count DESC
    LIMIT 1
)
SELECT
    s."county",
    s."school",
    s."closeddate"
FROM schools s
JOIN closed_counts cc
    ON s."county" = cc."county"
WHERE s."statustype" = 'Closed'
ORDER BY s."closeddate";
```

/* Schools offering a magnet program with K-8 grade span and Multiple Provision Types */
SELECT COUNT(*) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE s.magnet = 1
  AND f."Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND f."High Grade" = '8'
  AND f."NSLP Provision Status" = 'Multiple Provision Types';

/* Number of cities offering K-8 grade span and count of schools per city */
SELECT s.city,
       COUNT(DISTINCT s.cdscode) AS school_count
FROM schools s
JOIN frpm f ON s.cdscode = f.cdscode
WHERE f."Low Grade" = 'K'
  AND f."High Grade" = '8'
GROUP BY s.city
ORDER BY school_count DESC;
```

/* Рост суммарного объёма кредитов для клиентов-мужчин: сравнение 1996 и 1997 годов */
WITH yearly AS (
    SELECT
        EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l."date" AS DATE)) AS yr,
        SUM(l."amount") AS total_amount
    FROM "loan" l
    JOIN "account" a ON a."account_id" = l."account_id"
    JOIN "disp" d ON d."account_id" = a."account_id"
    JOIN "client" c ON c."client_id" = d."client_id"
    WHERE c."gender" = 'M'
      AND EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l."date" AS DATE)) IN (1996, 1997)
    GROUP BY EXTRACT(YEAR FROM CAST(l."date" AS DATE))
)
SELECT
    /* (сумма 1997 - сумма 1996) / сумма 1996 * 100 */
    (MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 1997 THEN total_amount END)
     - MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 1996 THEN total_amount END))
    / MAX(CASE WHEN yr = 1996 THEN total_amount END) * 100 AS growth_rate
FROM yearly;
```

/* Получаем все теги из постов пользователя Mark Meckes, у которых нет комментариев */
SELECT DISTINCT
    t."tagname"
FROM "posts" p
JOIN "users" u
    ON u."id" = p."owneruserid"
JOIN "tags" t
    ON t."tagname" = ANY(string_to_array(p."tags", '|'))
WHERE u."displayname" = 'Mark Meckes'
  AND p."commentcount" = 0
  AND p."tags" IS NOT NULL
  AND p."tags" <> '';
```

    ) AS percentage_difference

    /
    NULLIF(SUM(CASE WHEN e."event_name" = 'October Meeting' THEN b."amount" ELSE 0 END), 0)::numeric
    AS ratio
FROM "budget" b

        t."customerid",
        SUM(t."price") AS total_price,

    GROUP BY t."customerid"
),

        ct."customerid",

        ct.total_amount,

    ORDER BY ct.total_price DESC

)

    tc."customerid",
    tc.total_price,
    tc.avg_price_per_item,
    c."currency"
FROM top_customer tc
JOIN "customers" c ON c."customerid" = tc."customerid";
```

/* Вычисляем суммарное потребление по сегментам за 2012 и 2013 годы, затем процентное изменение */
WITH yearly_consumption AS (
    SELECT
        c."segment",
        SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) AS "year",
        SUM(ym."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" ym
    JOIN "customers" c ON ym."customerid" = c."customerid"
    WHERE c."currency" = 'EUR'
      AND SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
      AND c."segment" IN ('SME', 'LAM', 'KAM')
    GROUP BY c."segment", SUBSTRING(ym."date", 1, 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM yearly_consumption
    GROUP BY "segment"
),
percentage_change AS (
    SELECT
        "segment",
        "consumption_2012",
        "consumption_2013",
        (("consumption_2013" - "consumption_2012") / "consumption_2013") * 100 AS "percentage_increase"
    FROM pivoted
    WHERE "consumption_2012" IS NOT NULL
      AND "consumption_2013" IS NOT NULL
)
/* Определяем сегмент с наибольшим и наименьшим процентным ростом */

    "segment",
    "percentage_increase"
FROM percentage_change

/* Находим клиента, совершившего платёж 634.8 за 2012-08-25 */
WITH target_customer AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "customerid"
    FROM "transactions_1k"
    WHERE "date" = DATE '2012-08-25'
      AND "price" = 634.8
),
/* Суммарное потребление по годам для этого клиента */
yearly AS (
    SELECT
        y."customerid",
        LEFT(y."date", 4) AS "year",
        SUM(y."consumption") AS "total_consumption"
    FROM "yearmonth" y
    JOIN target_customer tc ON tc."customerid" = y."customerid"
    WHERE LEFT(y."date", 4) IN ('2012', '2013')
    GROUP BY y."customerid", LEFT(y."date", 4)
),
pivoted AS (
    SELECT
        "customerid",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2012' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2012",
        MAX(CASE WHEN "year" = '2013' THEN "total_consumption" END) AS "consumption_2013"
    FROM yearly
    GROUP BY "customerid"
)
/* Расчёт темпа снижения потребления */
SELECT
    "customerid",
    "consumption_2012",
    "consumption_2013",
    ("consumption_2012" - "consumption_2013") / "consumption_2012" AS "consumption_decrease_rate"
FROM pivoted;
